title: 7 scripts/release/*.sh ship a --self-test that no CI step, Makefile target or check_ wrapper runs; check_guards_are_wired.sh cannot see scripts/release/
evidence: at 8d021f61e1: 13 scripts/release/*.sh ship --self-test. A grep of .github, ci, Makefile and scripts/check_*.sh for '<name>.sh ... --self-test' finds: rc_cut and rc_publish_gate (rc-cut.yml); carry_milestone_items, t2_preflight and tag_coverage_gate (check_ wrappers). DARK: asset_version_check (wired by the #4275 PR through scripts/check_release_asset_version.sh), stamp_rc_version (cargo is its oracle, so it needs a named ci/sections.yml step and cop approval), fleet_cells_gate, models_t1, ont_complete_gate, prepare_bump, promote_rc, rc_fleet_stage. check_guards_are_wired.sh globs scripts/*.sh at depth 1 (comment at :131).
ask: widen check_guards_are_wired.sh universe to scripts/**/ (re-mutate in the new scope, CLAUDE.md rule 4) and wire or baseline the 7 remaining tables
